recognize_zh: 整片單一形態、中大型淋巴樣細胞呈瀰漫性排列，核染色質細而分散、有小核仁，且可見多個核分裂象，符合母細胞樣（blastoid）套細胞淋巴瘤的高增生表現。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous medium-to-large lymphoid cells
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed, blast-like chromatin
Small but distinct nucleoli in many cells
Scant pale cytoplasm; high N:C ratio
Numerous mitotic figures and scattered apoptotic bodies
Occasional small hyalinized vessels; no follicles or starry-sky pattern in this field
describe_en: Sections show effacement by a diffuse, monotonous proliferation of medium-to-large lymphoid cells. The cells have round to slightly irregular nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and scant cytoplasm. Mitotic figures are readily identified and apoptotic bodies are scattered, but a well-developed starry-sky pattern is not seen. Scattered small hyalinized vessels are present. In the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD5+, cyclin D1+/SOX11+), findings are consistent with blastoid variant of mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are TdT-positive and cyclin D1-negative, whereas blastoid MCL is TdT-negative, surface Ig-positive and cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
DLBCL usually has larger cells with vesicular chromatin and more prominent nucleoli and lacks cyclin D1 and t(11;14).
Burkitt shows a starry-sky pattern with squared-off cells and a near-100% Ki-67, and is CD10+/BCL6+, cyclin D1-negative with MYC rearrangement.
Myeloid sarcoma may show eosinophilic myelocytes and is MPO/CD33/CD117-positive and CD20/PAX5-negative.
